title: Correct Shortfall Amount on a Commercial Natural Gas Supply Swing Shortfall Line
content:
A swing shortfall correction on a Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement is worked on the agreement's most recently posted swing shortfall charge line, taken with the energy charge line of the same billing period start. The over-billed amount on that shortfall line is its billed amount less the correct shortfall amount, never below zero, and it is returned as one rebill credit tied to the line and dated on the correction date.

## Worksheet lines

| Quantity | How it is found |
|---|---|
| Shortfall line | The most recently posted swing shortfall charge line: its billed amount, its therms, its rate per therm, and its billing period start and end |
| Cycle usage | The therms on the energy charge line with the same billing period start |
| Billed lower end | The cycle usage plus the therms on the shortfall line, that is the lower end of the band the line was billed against under the plan in force on the cycle's billing period start |
| Monthly contract volume | The contracted annual therms on the agreement divided by 12, rounded half up to a whole therm |
| Correct shortfall therms | The billed lower end less the cycle usage, never below zero |
| Shortfall charge per therm | The rate per therm on the shortfall line |
| Correct shortfall amount | The correct shortfall therms multiplied by the shortfall charge per therm, rounded half up to the cent |
| Over-billed amount | The billed amount of the shortfall line less the correct shortfall amount, never below zero |
| Shortfall rebill credit | The over-billed amount, together with a service recovery credit only where one is due, rounded half up to the cent; posted as a negative amount |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

The most recent swing shortfall line of a Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 agreement shows 300 therms at $0.0600 per therm and a billed amount of $21.00. The energy charge line of the same cycle shows 700 therms.

- Billed lower end: 700 plus 300 is 1,000 therms.
- Correct shortfall therms: 1,000 less 700 is 300 therms.
- Correct shortfall amount: 300 multiplied by $0.0600 is $18.00.
- Over-billed amount: $21.00 less $18.00 is $3.00. Where no service recovery credit is due, the shortfall rebill credit is $3.00, posted as minus $3.00.

## Edge case

Where the correct shortfall amount equals or exceeds the billed amount of the line, the over-billed amount is $0.00 and there is nothing over-billed to return.
